items.text: Amadodana kaJuda; noPerezi, noHezironi, noKarmi, noHure, noShobali.
UReyaya, indodana kaShobali, wayenguyise kaJahati; uJahati wazala o-Ahumayi noLahadi. Lezi ziyizizukulwane zamaSorati.
Babevela kuyise ka-Etamu; iJizreyeli, neJisma, noJidibas; igama lodadewabo lalinguHaseleponi.
NoPenuweli, uyise kaGedori, no-Ezeri, uyise kaHusa. Lawa angamadodana kaHure, izibulo lika-Efratha, uyise kaBetlehema.
U-Ashuri, uyise kaThekhowa, wayenabafazi ababili, uHela noNahara.
UNahara wamzalela u-Ahuzam, noHeferi, noThemeni, noHahashitari. Lawa kwakungamadodana kaNahara.
Amadodana kaHela: ngoSereti, no-Izowari, no-Etinani.
UKhosi wazala o-Anubi noSobeba nemindeni ka-Ahariheli indodana kaHarumu.
UJabezi wayetuseka kunabafowabo; unina wambiza ngokuthi uJabezi, wathi: “Ngokuba ngamzala ngosizi.”

UJabezi wakhuleka kuNkulunkulu ka-Israyeli, wathi: “O, uma ubufuna nokungibusisa, wandise umkhawulo wami, isandla sakho sibe nami, ungivikele ebubini, ngingadabuki! Futhi uNkulunkulu wamnika lokho akucelayo.
UKelubi, umfowabo kaShuwa, wayenguyise kaMehiri, owayenguyise ka-Eston.
U-Eston wazala uBetrafa, noPaseha, noThehina, uyise ka-Irinahasi. Lawa amadoda kaRega.
Amadodana kaKenase ngu u-Otheniyeli noSeraya; namadodana ka-Otheniyeli; Hathath.
UMeonothayi wazala u-Ofira, uSeraya wazala uJowabe, uyise wesigodi saseKarasimi; ngoba babeyizingcweti.
Amadodana kaKalebi, indodana kaJefune; u-Iru, u-Ela noNahama; amadodana ka-Ela kwakunguKenazi.
Amadodana kaJehaleli ngu uZifi noZifa, uThiriya no-Azareli.
Amadodana ka-Ezra: ngoJetheri, noMeredi, no-Eferi, noJaloni; wazala oMiriyamu, noSamayi, no-Ishiba, uyise ka-Estemowa.
Umkakhe uJuda wazala uYarede, uyise kaGedori, noHebhere, uyise kaSogo, noJekutiyeli, uyise kaSanowa. Lawa angamadodana kaBitiya, indodakazi kaFaro, owathatha uMredi.
Amadodana omkakhe uHodiya, udadewabo kaNahamu, uyise kaKehila umGarmi, no-Estemowa umMahaga.
Amadodana kaShimoni ayengo-Amnoni, noRina, noBeni Hanani, noThiloni. Amadodana kaIshi: ngoSuheti noBeni-Zoheti.
Amadodana kaShela indodana kaJuda: ngo-Eri, uyise kaLeka, noLada, uyise kaMaresa, nemindeni yendlu yabasebenza ilineni elicolekileyo, bendlu ka-Ashibeya,
noJokimi, namadoda akwaKoseba, noJowashi, noSarafi, ababebusa kwaMowabi, naseYasubilehem. Futhi lezi izinto ezindala.
Laba babengababumbi nabahlala phakathi kwezitshalo nasezintangweni; bahlala khona nenkosi emsebenzini wayo.
Amadodana kaSimeyoni kwakunguNemuweli, noJamini, noJaribi, noSeraki, noSawule.
Indodana yakhe uShalumi, indodana yakhe uMibisamu, indodana yakhe uMishima.
Amadodana kaMishima ngu uHamuweli indodana yakhe, uSaguri indodana yakhe, uShimeyi indodana yakhe.
USimeyi wayenamadodana ayishumi nesithupha namadodakazi ayisithupha; kodwa abafowabo babengenabantwana abaningi, futhi yonke inzalo yabo ayizange yande njengabantwana bakwaJuda.
Bahlala eBherisheba, naseMolada, naseHasarishuali,
naseBhiliha, nase-Eshimu, naseTholadi,
naseBetuweli, naseHorma, naseZikilagi;
naseBeti-Markabhoti, naseHasarsusimi, naseBeti Bireyi, naseSarayimi. Le yayiyimizi yabo kwaze kwaba sekubuseni kukaDavide.
Imizi yabo yayiyi: Etamu, ne-Ayini, neRimoni, neThokheni, ne-Asan, imizi emihlanu;
nayo yonke imizana yabo eyayizungeza leyo mizi, kwaze kwaba seBali. Lezi kwakuyizindawo zabo zokuhlala nezizukulwane zabo.
NoMesobabi, noJamleki, noJosa indodana ka-Amasiya,
noJoweli noJehu indodana kaJosibiya indodana kaSeraya indodana ka-Asiyeli,
no-Eliyohenayi, noJakobe, noJohaya, no-Asaya, no-Adiyeli, noJeshimiyeli, noBenaya,
noSisa, indodana kaSifi, indodana ka-Aloni, indodana kaJedaya, indodana kaZimri, indodana kaShemaya;
Labo ababizwa ngamagama babeyizikhulu ezizukulwaneni zabo, nezindlu zawoyise zanda kakhulu.
Bahamba baze bafika ekungeneni kweGedori ngasempumalanga kwesigodi ukufunela izimvu zabo idlelo.
Bafumana idlelo elivundile nelihle, nezwe lalibanzi, linokuthula, linokuthula; ngokuba abakaHamu babehlala khona kudala.

Laba abalotshiweyo ngamagama bafika emihleni kaHezekiya inkosi yakwaJuda, bachitha amatende abo nezindlu zabo zokuhlala ezazitholakala khona, bababulala ngesiqalekiso kuze kube namuhla, bahlala emakamelweni abo, ngokuba kwakukhona inqaba. Idlelo lemfuyo yabo.
Abanye kubo, emadodaneni kaSimeyoni, amadoda angamakhulu ayisihlanu, baya entabeni yaseSeyiri, benoPhelathiya, noNeyariya, noRefaya, no-Uziyeli, amadodana ka-Ishi, izinhloko.
Bachitha insali yama-Amaleki akhululiweyo, bahlala khona kuze kube namuhla.
